scope: Corollary 1.2 (Sharp singular-set bound) of the manuscript “The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers” (preprints/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 367 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eb1a535a1d8a9dc4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 2, let D ⊂ Rn be open, and let u ∈ H1 loc(D) be a nonnegative local minimizer of the one-phase Bernoulli energy in D. Its interior free boundary is smooth outside Sing(u). This set is empty when n ≤ 6, is locally finite when n = 7, and satisfies dimH Sing(u) ≤ n − 7 (n ≥ 7). For every n ≥ 7, a global minimizer attains this dimension bound.
